payload.claim: The docstring for write_follow_ups says 'Every head and range comes from `stack.fields` through `graded_fields`, falling back to `end_review.layer_fields`'s packaged head for a layer absent from it.' But the function also computes `packaged_head` (line 332) by calling `end_review.layer_fields` directly, bypassing `graded_fields` and `stack.fields` entirely and unconditionally, not only as a fallback for a missing layer. That head is embedded in the prompt text the function builds, so the blanket claim that every head comes from stack.fields through graded_fields is not true of this one; the more precise behavior is only spelled out in `_prompt`'s own docstring a few lines below.
